data.body: SC9-PATH-NOTE: The Jira bridge audit file was committed to docs/designs/3e74-56da-jira-bridge-audit.md rather than the epic spec's plugins/dso/docs/designs/ path. CLAUDE.md Architectural Invariant #3 prohibits dev-team artifacts (audit logs, design docs, investigation findings) from being placed inside plugins/dso/ — that tree is a distributed artifact and only plugin-shipped content belongs there. The spec path was a drafting error; the actual path honors the invariant. The file content (bridge is format-agnostic, no ID format assumptions) is complete and correct.
